stepOne.desktopDesc: Choose where your package will be picked up and delivered.
stepOne.tabletDesc: Choose the route first, then continue with package information.
stepOne.mobileDesc: Start with the route only. Package details come in the next step.
stepOne.pickupDesc: Choose the origin point where the package enters the route.
stepOne.dropDesc: Choose the destination point for final delivery.
stepOne.pickupFirstDesc: Drop options are filtered after you choose a pickup point.
stepOne.responsiveDescDesktop: Desktop leaves more room for route context and the next booking steps.

stepTwo.desktopDesc: Provide details of the package you want to send.
stepTwo.tabletDesc: Tablet keeps package controls visible without overloading the form.
stepTwo.mobileDesc: Phone view focuses on only the fields you need right now.

stepTwo.dateConflictAlert: Changing date for this package will change the date for all the packages in your cart.

stepThree.desktopDesc: Review your order details and proceed to payment.
stepThree.tabletDesc: Tablet keeps route, package, and checkout details balanced.
stepThree.mobileDesc: Phone view shows the essentials first. Expand package details only when needed.
stepThree.noPackages: No packages are in the cart yet. Add at least one package before reviewing payment.
stepThree.placeholderInfo: Package details will appear here once items are added.
stepThree.couponApplied: Coupon applied! You got a {discount}% discount.
stepThree.noCoupons: No coupons are available right now.
stepThree.pricingPlaceholder: Pricing will appear after route and package details are ready.
stepThree.noSpaceForQuantity: Not enough space for the selected quantity
stepThree.noSpaceForQuantityDesc: We could not find nearby dates with enough space for {count} items on this route. Try placing one quantity per order and check again.
stepThree.noSpaceAtAllDesc: There is not enough capacity for this order even with one quantity. Redirecting you to support for help with the next available option.
stepThree.dateFullDesc: The selected date {date} is full for this route. Pick another date here and pricing will refresh automatically.
stepThree.noOtherDates: No other route dates are available right now.
